srvmr.option.enabled.tooltip: Rebuilds the picture VulkanMod Reforged draws at its Render Scale at full resolution. Needs an NVIDIA RTX card and a Render Scale below 100 %.
srvmr.option.renderScale.tooltip: VulkanMod Reforged's own Render Scale: the size the world is drawn at before DLSS. Lower is faster on the graphics card; at 100 % DLSS does not run. Below 50 % only with DLSS on: 33 % is Ultra Performance.
srvmr.option.quality.tooltip: Auto takes the DLSS mode that fits the Render Scale. A mode chosen here is used while the Render Scale fits it; at another scale the mode that fits is used, since DLSS has a model made for each mode's own scale.
srvmr.option.jitter.tooltip: Moves the picture by less than a pixel each frame, which DLSS needs for detail. Off only to compare.
srvmr.option.invertJitterX.tooltip: Try if the picture shimmers sideways while standing still.
srvmr.option.invertJitterY.tooltip: Try if the picture shimmers up and down while standing still.
srvmr.option.invertMotionY.tooltip: Try if the picture smears when looking up and down.
srvmr.option.packDepth.tooltip: How a shader pack's depth is stored. Change only if the picture smears with a shader pack on.
srvmr.option.packDepthUpsideDown.tooltip: Whether a shader pack's depth has its rows the other way round from the picture.
srvmr.option.vanillaDepth.tooltip: How VulkanMod Reforged's own depth is stored. Change only if the picture smears without a shader pack.
